text:
mia: Heads-up: my PR for the migration guide (RFC -> stable) is blocked by docs CI. preview failed with a couple of anchor warnings and a Vale rule on the SDK snippet.
ci-bot: docs preview failed for PR #4821 on branch `docs/migration-rfc->stable`
- link-check: 2 anchor warnings
- vale: 1 error (PassiveVoice.Short) in `sdk-snippets.md`
- md-lint: line-length warnings (non-blocking)
alex: Can you paste the exact anchor warnings? I want to see if it's just a missing header or a markdown anchor formatting issue.
mia: Sure — copy from the CI log:```
WARN: broken anchor in migration-guide.md: target `#rolling-upgrades` not found
WARN: broken anchor in migration-guide.md: target `#config-profiles` not found
```
lina: Those anchors were renamed in the earlier restructure commit — the headers are now `## Rolling upgrades` and `## Config profiles` (space vs dash changed). Link checker expects kebab-case anchors. We can either update the links to use the explicit anchor text or add HTML anchors under the headers.
sam: The Vale error is small, here's the excerpt from sdk-snippets.md:```
> When you pass the `max_tokens` parameter the model will stop sooner and may produce incomplete sentences.
```
Vale flagged PassiveVoice.Short on "the model will stop" — rule we run is a bit strict for example prose.
mia: Ugh. I can do the anchor fixes, but don't want to re-run CI a bunch. Can we bundle the anchor fixes + Vale suppression in one patch so it passes once?
jeremy: Yes please bundle. Also note the release merge window is today at 17:00 PT; if CI passes we should try to get it into the 17:30 merge batch. Otherwise it waits until tomorrow.
alex: For anchors, easiest fix: update the links to exact header text with an explicit anchor. e.g., change `[rolling upgrades](#rolling-upgrades)` to `[rolling upgrades](#rolling-upgrades "Rolling upgrades")` — or better, link to the header written as it appears `#rolling-upgrades` but ensure the header slug matches. I prefer making the link match existing header slugs rather than adding HTML anchors.
lina: I can take the anchor edits. Mia — want the Vale bit? I can add an inline comment to the snippet that silences Vale for that specific sentence using `# nolint: PassiveVoice.Short`? Not sure if Vale supports per-line ignores in MD though.
sam: Vale supports a short-circuit by wrapping text in a code block or using a suppression comment in a fenced code block:```yaml
<!-- vale: off PassiveVoice.Short -->
Your explanatory sentence.
<!-- vale: on PassiveVoice.Short -->
```
But that looks messy in docs examples. Alternative: reword the sentence to active voice: "Setting `max_tokens` reduces the model's output length and may truncate sentences." That should satisfy Vale and be clearer.
mia: Rewording sounds better. I'll change the sentence and update the two broken anchors in migration-guide.md. I'll push one commit with all fixes in ~15 mins.
ci-bot: Suggestion: run the docs linter locally to avoid multiple CI runs: `make docs-lint` (runs linkcheck + vale + mdlint). Also you can run `tools/slugify.py migration-guide.md` to preview header slugs.
mia: Thanks — running `make docs-lint` now locally. If anyone wants to review the commit before I push, ping here.
alex: I'll give a quick pass when you post the PR update. If you need a second reviewer for merge, @jeremy or I can quick-approve after CI passes.
lina: One more small note: there are two relative links from other pages that point at `migration-guide.md#config-profiles` — I will update those to the new slug `#config-profiles` consistent casing. I'll open a tiny follow-up PR if you don't want to bundle.
mia: Pushed: commit `b7f2c9a` -> branch `docs/migration-rfc->stable` with all fixes. PR auto-updated.
ci-bot: CI queued for PR #4821. Running preview...
Status: link-check: OK, vale: OK (1 warning remaining: style.Primer.* but non-blocking), md-lint: OK
Preview URL: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-4821
alex: Looks good on preview. I spot-checked the SDK snippet and the new wording is much clearer. :thumbsup:
jeremy: CI green and within the merge window. @alex @sam — can one of you approve? I'll slot it for the 17:30 merge batch once approved.
sam: Approved. Quick note: I ran `tools/slugify.py` locally to confirm slugs, LGTM.
alex: Approved. @ci-bot please proceed with merge queue slot.
ci-bot: PR #4821 approved by alex, sam. Added to merge batch for 17:30 PT.
Merged at 17:31 PT — commit `b7f2c9a` — Migration guide anchor and SDK wording fixes.
mia: Thanks everyone — sorry for the back-and-forth. Learned to run `make docs-lint` before pushing next time.
jeremy: Nice work. If the follow-up link cleanup PR exists, please tag me and I'll fast-track it in tomorrow's merge window.
